item.title: Yajuu Kyoushi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Authoring Heaven
  • 発売日: 2010-07-23
  • スコア: 6.470000000000001/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 野獣教師
  • 英語名: Yajuu Kyoushi

あらすじ

At a certain private school, the tuition is high and the education is decent. If there are serious students, delinquents are also present.

The protagonist is a new appointed teacher.

With her flashy clothes and rude behavior, the students look at her with awe rather than admiration.

Thanks to her father being a respected figure of the Board of Education and her grandfather being a powerful local politician, she doesn’t have to worry about being fired.

あらすじ

Sakumi is just married. She loves sex and now lives with her husband, Koutaro, father-in-law, and brother-in-law. One day, Koutaro goes abroad on business. When he leaves, he tells Sakumi, “Have sex with my father and brother while I’m away.” She has no objection what he says and soon starts approaching. Well, what will happen to her family…?

あらすじ

However, it is harder than he expects and peculiar residents also annoy him. He wants to quit, but there lives some beautiful housewives. “Well, I hope something good might happen….”

item.title: Onegai! Iinchou!!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Authoring Heaven
  • 発売日: 2006-07-21

  • 日本語名: お願い！委員長!!
  • 英語名: Onegai! Iinchou!!

あらすじ

Stevenson is a genius and starts his career as a teacher. But he is young, innocent and has no sense of direction. On his first day of the school, he doesn’t find even the teacher’s room. While he walks around the school, a girl, Chigusa, helps him go to the teacher’s room. Chigusa, Haruko and Kanae are good friends and Chigusa starts to like Stevenson. Triggered by Haruko’s idea that “He has no confidence as a man.”, he has lessons to be a man. Sometimes gently, sometimes severely…. Will he be able to be a real man through H lessons…?
